Right margin holds two notes: "1. Abyssina." beside the opening, and "Abyssinorum I ortus" beside the second explicatio. Signature "E 6" and catchword "chi" at the foot.

main_text.head: ABYSSINA.
Periodus 1.
Canon.
main_text.p: 1. Abyssina.Imperium Abyssinum an-te aliquot secula potentissimū fuit.
main_text.head: Explicatio. 1.
main_text.p: De Origine Abyssynorum certi ni-hil constat: sunt enim in Arabia Fe-lici ejusdem nominis gentes, ut in-certum sit ex Æthiopia in Arabiam, an ex Arabia in Æthiopiam migra-rint.
main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Ipsi Abyssini sese origine Chal-Abyssi-norum I ortusdæos profitentur, quod vero non ab-similē est; quandoquidem ex Assy-ria in Æthiopiam coloniam dedu-ctam testatur Nicephorus l. 9. c. 18. & Scaliger de Emend. temp. l. 6. c. 3. Antiquissimæ ipsorum & res & reges ignorantur. Extat quidem Catalogus regum Abyssinorum à Christo Noa-

page.notes: The first word of the explicatio 2 note and the side margin note "Abyssinorum I ortus" are read from the scan with the hyphen at the line end; the reading "Abyssi-norum" is probable. The word "similē" is read as printed with a tilde-like mark; the reading "similē" is uncertain. The word "Christo" is set in italic and its long s is read as "f" in the print; the reading "Christo" is as printed. The catchword "chi" completes "Noachi".
